medium: the creator at a desk under a lightbox sign; cutaways are widescreen clips letterboxed on black - keynote stages and film scenes; bold white caps captions with one hot-pink word
avoid: illustration, cartoon, 3D render, vertical-framed cutaways, bright flat studio light, text baked into the image
note: Almost all talking head. Both cutaway looks are widescreen frames letterboxed on black - the black bars ARE the look. Caption: bold white caps, centred mid-frame, one keyword in hot pink. Reference stills are cropped to the slide band so his caption is not in them.

looks.label: Creator at the desk
looks.when: the creator on camera - never generated.

looks.label: Keynote slide on a dark stage
looks.when: a famous example, a product, a big reveal, a moment of great communication - shown as a slide on a giant stage screen.
looks.prompt: A widescreen 16:9 frame letterboxed with black bars above and below: a dark conference stage, a huge screen showing one large object or icon on a black or deep-purple slide, a small speaker figure in silhouette at the far left, soft stage haze. Archival keynote footage, slightly soft video quality, no words on the slide.

looks.label: Film scene, letterboxed
looks.when: a scene between people - a pitch, a meeting, an interview, someone doing it right or wrong - shown as a movie scene.
looks.prompt: A widescreen 16:9 frame letterboxed with black bars above and below: a cinematic scene of two or three people in a dim office or boardroom, seen in profile or three-quarter, mid-conversation, muted teal-and-grey grade, soft window light, shallow focus, film grain. Nobody looks at the camera, no text.
